name: local-agent-bridge
description: CortexIDE coding agent on local models (vLLM / Ollama), Claude (Anthropic API) or the Claude Code engine, with file, search and shell tools, SKILL.md skills, .canvas.tsx canvases, and chat import (including Cursor exports).

commands.title: Agent: Run Prompt on Several Models
Agent: Open Session Indexes (master / folder / chat)
Agent: Set Chat Limits (output tokens, rounds, effort for this chat)
Agent: Generate Memory From This Chat

chatParticipants.name: local-agent
chatParticipants.description: Coding agent that reads SKILL.md files and canvases

commands.name: import
commands.description: Import a chat export (.md, e.g. from Cursor) and continue as an agent

disambiguation.description: The user wants an agent that follows SKILL.md skills, writes canvases, or does multi-step coding work with tools.
examples: Follow the canvas skill and write a dashboard
Act as a coding agent and edit the codebase

languageModelTools.name: list_skills
languageModelTools.modelDescription: List SKILL.md skills with name, description, and path.

languageModelTools.name: read_skill
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the full SKILL.md body for a skill by name. Call before following a skill.

languageModelTools.name: match_skills
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Find skills matching a task query.

languageModelTools.name: read_canvas
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a .canvas.tsx canvas by name or path.

languageModelTools.name: import_cursor_chat
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Import a Cursor chat export (.md) or agent transcript (.jsonl) into .cortexide/imported-chats and return an Agent-mode continuation prompt.
languageModelTools.userDescription: Import a Cursor chat and continue as an agent

path.description: Absolute path to a Cursor export .md or .jsonl

localAgentBridge.syncOnStartup.description: Sync SKILL.md skills into .cortexide/skills and rewrite agent/canvas rules when CortexIDE starts.

localAgentBridge.includeBuiltInSkills.description: Include ~/.cursor/skills-cursor (Cursor built-in skills such as canvas).

localAgentBridge.extraSkillRoots.description: Extra directories to scan for SKILL.md files.

localAgentBridge.maxSkills.description: CortexIDE only loads 64 slash-command skills. Extra catalog entries stay in the rule file and MCP tools.

enumDescriptions: vLLM / SGLang router if running, otherwise Ollama, otherwise Claude when credentials are set
vLLM or the Qud Lab SGLang router (:30000, then :8000)
Ollama (:11434), using its native API so num_ctx is honoured
Claude through the Anthropic Messages API (api.anthropic.com). Key from “Agent: Set Claude API Key”, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or `ant auth login`.
The installed Claude Code CLI runs the agent — the same engine as the Claude app, with its own tools, skills, CLAUDE.md, MCP servers and subagents.
Any OpenAI-compatible URL set in localAgentBridge.agent.baseUrl
localAgentBridge.agent.provider.description: Model backend for the Agent panel.

localAgentBridge.agent.baseUrl.description: Override the backend URL (ending in /v1; for Claude, an API gateway in front of api.anthropic.com). Empty = provider defaults.

localAgentBridge.agent.model.description: Model id. Empty = first preferred model the backend serves.

localAgentBridge.agent.apiKey.description: Bearer key for the backend. Empty = %LOCALAPPDATA%QudLabllm-proxy-key.txt for vLLM. For Claude prefer “Agent: Set Claude API Key”, which uses Secret Storage.

localAgentBridge.agent.contextTokens.description: Context window to plan for. 0 = read max_model_len from the backend (Ollama: min(model limit, ollamaNumCtx); Claude: min(model window, 200k)).

localAgentBridge.agent.ollamaNumCtx.description: num_ctx sent to Ollama. Higher = more VRAM.

localAgentBridge.agent.maxOutputTokens.description: Max tokens per model reply on local backends (Claude uses claudeMaxOutputTokens). Thinking models (qwen3, deepseek-r1) need more, e.g. 4096-8192.

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeMaxOutputTo.description: Max tokens per Claude reply, thinking included. Replaces maxOutputTokens on the Claude backend.

enumDescriptions: The model's own default (medium on Claude Opus 5.5, high on most others)
Fewest thinking tokens; cheapest and fastest
Best for hard coding and long agentic tasks
Correctness over cost
localAgentBridge.agent.claudeEffort.description: Claude reasoning effort (output_config.effort). Only sent to models with adaptive thinking (Claude 4.6 and later).

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeWorkspaceId.description: Anthropic workspace id (wrkspc_…) sent as anthropic-workspace-id. Needed with a user-scoped key (sk-ant-usr-…); workspace-scoped keys leave it empty. Empty = ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID from the environment.

localAgentBridge.agent.claudeCodePath.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI for the claude-code backend. Empty = claude on PATH, then %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe.

enumDescriptions: File edits are applied without asking; shell commands follow localAgentBridge.agent.shell
Claude Code's auto mode: a classifier decides what may run
Plan only: nothing is changed
Anything that would need approval is denied (the panel cannot show Claude Code's prompts)
localAgentBridge.agent.claudeCodePermiss.description: Permission mode for the claude-code backend. The panel runs Claude Code headless, so a call that would prompt is denied and reported.

enumDescriptions: Use the bridge's Anthropic key when one is set, otherwise Claude Code's own login
Always the bridge's Anthropic key (Secret Storage, apiKey setting or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), with claudeWorkspaceId
Always Claude Code's own login (run claude and /login once); API keys in the environment are not passed on

localAgentBridge.agent.maxRounds.description: Max model↔tool rounds per request before the agent is asked to wrap up.

localAgentBridge.agent.shell.description: Shell tool: run without asking, ask for each command, or disabled. Obviously destructive commands are always blocked.

localAgentBridge.agent.writableRoots.description: Folders outside the open workspace that the agent may edit and run commands in (e.g. a game's Mods folder).

localAgentBridge.agent.readAnywhere.description: Let the agent read files outside the workspace (writes stay limited to workspace + writableRoots).

localAgentBridge.agent.requireReadBefore.description: Refuse whole-file Write over a file the agent has not Read, loose (indentation-tolerant) edits to unread files, and any edit to a file that changed on disk since the agent read it. Exact StrReplace matches are always allowed.

localAgentBridge.agent.diagnosticsAfterE.description: After each edit, wait briefly for the language server and add that file's errors to the edit result.

localAgentBridge.agent.subagents.description: Offer the Task tool: a read-only research sub-agent with its own context (uses extra model calls).

localAgentBridge.agent.historyDir.description: Folder for the chat history cache (one folder per workspace, one file per chat, like ~/.claude/projects). Empty = %USERPROFILE%\.cortexide\agent.

localAgentBridge.agent.historyLimit.description: Chats kept per workspace. Past this, the oldest chats that are not pinned, open as a tab or running are deleted.

localAgentBridge.agent.maxParallel.description: How many chats may run at the same time (each on its own model). 0 = no limit. Parallel chats share the workspace, so edits to the same files can collide.

enumDescriptions: Claude: yes. Ollama: from the model's capabilities. Others: from the model name (qwen2.5-vl, llava, gemma3, pixtral…)
Always send images (the model must support them, or the request fails)
Never send images; ReadImage returns size and format only
localAgentBridge.agent.vision.description: Whether the agent sends images to the model: images linked in your message, and the ones ReadImage / AnalyzeFile open.

localAgentBridge.agent.imageMaxEdge.description: Images are scaled down to this long edge (pixels) before they go to the model. Smaller = fewer tokens.

localAgentBridge.agent.maxImages.description: Newest images kept in a chat's conversation (and linked images attached per message). Older ones are replaced by a note the model can follow up with ReadImage.

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers (stdio) the agent can use through its `McpTools` / `McpCall` tools, in the same format as `~/.cursor/mcp.json` and `~/.claude.json`: `{ "name": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "pkg"], "env": {}, "description": "..." } }`. `"disabled": true` turns off one, including an imported or auto-detected one. Not used by the Claude Code engine.

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpImport.markdownDescription: Also use the MCP servers configured for Cursor (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`) and / or Claude Code (`~/.claude.json`). `mcpServers` entries win on a name clash.

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpAutoRea.markdownDescription: Add REA (Reverse Engineer Anything, MIT) as MCP server `rea` when `Tools\Fetch-ThirdParty.ps1 -AgentBridge` has installed it under `thirdPartyDir` or a workspace's `Tools\Shared\third_party`. Needs Node 22.19+ on PATH (or `mcpNodePath`).

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpNodePath.description: node executable used to run REA (empty = node on PATH).

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpMode.description: McpCall: run MCP tools without asking, ask before each call, or refuse them (McpTools listing still works).

localAgentBridge.agent.mcpTimeoutSec.description: Seconds one MCP tool call may take before it is abandoned.

localAgentBridge.agent.thirdPartyDir.markdownDescription: Folder with optional third-party libraries fetched by `Tools\Fetch-ThirdParty.ps1 -AgentBridge` (REA, pdf.js). Empty = each workspace's `Tools\Shared\third_party`. They are loaded at run time, never bundled into the VSIX.

enumDescriptions: The maxOutputTokens / claudeMaxOutputTokens, maxRounds and claudeEffort settings
Local 8192 / Claude 32000 output tokens, 80 rounds, Claude effort at least high
Local 16384 / Claude 64000 output tokens, 150 rounds, Claude effort at least xhigh
localAgentBridge.agent.defaultSessionLim.description: Output limits new chats start with. Each chat can be changed on its own with “Agent: Set Chat Limits” or the panel menu. Presets only raise the settings; outputs are capped to the model's limit (Claude) or half the context window (local models).

localAgentBridge.agent.memory.markdownDescription: Memory between chats: what the agent remembers about you (every workspace) and about this project, as Markdown files under the history folder (`memory/` and `projects/<workspace>/memory/`). The index goes into every prompt, and the agent can save (`MemoryWrite`) and delete (`MemoryDelete`) memories. Review them with *Agent: Manage Memory*.

localAgentBridge.agent.memoryGenerate.markdownDescription: Generate memory from chats: every `memoryGenerateEvery` turns (and when a chat is compacted), the chat's model reads the recent turns in the background and adds, updates or removes memories. Secrets are never stored. Not on the Claude Code engine, which keeps its own memory.

localAgentBridge.agent.memoryGenerateEve.markdownDescription: Turns between memory generation passes for a chat.

localAgentBridge.agent.memoryIncludeSens.markdownDescription: Allow generated memory to include sensitive topics you shared, such as health conditions or religious beliefs. Off: they are left out.

localAgentBridge.agent.memorySearchChats.markdownDescription: Search and reference chats: the agent gets `ChatSearch` and `ChatRead` to find and read your earlier chats (this workspace, or all of them) when you refer to past work.

localAgentBridge.agent.memoryPromptChars.markdownDescription: Most characters of memory put into each prompt (the newest memories in full, older ones by their one-line description).

enumDescriptions: On Ollama, a model that clearly struggles (cannot call tools, keeps announcing instead of acting, keeps failing edits, loops, stalls, or uses all rounds without a change) hands the request to a stronger installed model, which reads the chat and the first attempt
Never switch models by itself
localAgentBridge.agent.autoSwitch.markdownDescription: Switch the chat to a stronger Ollama model when the current one is not up to the request. The new model gets the chat history and a handoff of what the previous model tried, and the chat keeps the new model.

localAgentBridge.agent.autoSwitchModels.markdownDescription: Ollama models to switch to first, in order (e.g. `["qwen2.5-coder:14b", "devstral"]`). After these, installed models that can call tools are tried, coding and larger models first.

localAgentBridge.agent.autoSwitchMax.markdownDescription: Most model switches in one turn.

localAgentBridge.agent.autoCompactPercen.markdownDescription: Auto-compact: before a turn, a chat whose carried-over history would fill more than this percent of the model's context window is compacted first (as `/compact` does), then your message runs on the summary. `0` turns it off. Chats on the Claude Code engine compact themselves.

localAgentBridge.agent.compressRecentTur.markdownDescription: `/compress [focus]` (alias `/compact`) replaces a chat's history with a summary written by the chat's model. This many of the latest turns go to the summariser in full (prompts, tool calls with results, answers, changed files) and are summarised in detail; older turns are shortened and summarised briefly.

enumDescriptions: Enter while a chat works steers it: the message is taken into the running turn at its next step, and the task goes on with it
Enter while a chat works queues the message: it runs as the next turn when this one ends
localAgentBridge.agent.steerDefault.markdownDescription: What **Enter** does while a chat is working. **Alt+Enter** does the other one, and **Ctrl+Shift+Enter** stops the turn and sends the message. Messages that arrive too late to steer run as the next turn. After **Stop**, or a failed turn, nothing runs by itself: waiting messages go back into the input box. `/compress` sent while a chat works runs as soon as the turn ends (with **Ctrl+Shift+Enter**: stops the turn and compresses at once). **Agent: Steer Running Chat…** reaches running chats in other windows too.

localAgentBridge.agent.instructions.markdownDescription: Extra instruction files added to the agent's system prompt after `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` / `.cursorrules` and `alwaysApply` rules in `.cursor/rules`. Paths or globs in the last segment (`docs/agent/*.md`); relative ones are looked up in each workspace folder, `~` is your home folder. URLs are skipped. (Design follows opencode's `instructions`.)

localAgentBridge.agent.permissions.markdownDescription: Permission rules for agent tool calls; the **last** matching rule wins (as in opencode). List form: `[{ "action": "shell", "resource": "git push *", "effect": "ask" }]` or strings like `"shell:git push *=deny"`. Map form: `{ "edit": "ask", "shell": { "rm *": "deny" } }`. Actions: `read`, `edit`, `glob`, `grep`, `shell`, `webfetch`, `subagent`, `mcp`, `skill`, `*`. Effects: `allow`, `ask`, `deny`. Chained shell commands are checked part by part. Reading `.env` files asks by default. Does not apply to the Claude Code backend.

enumDescriptions: A canvas an agent turn creates or changes opens beside the editor (an open one just re-renders)
Only canvases the turn created open by themselves
Never; the card in the chat opens it
localAgentBridge.agent.canvasAutoOpen.markdownDescription: Open canvases (`.canvas.tsx`) that the agent writes beside the editor when its turn ends.

enumDescriptions: Opening or focusing the Local Agent shows the New Tab page when the editor area is empty or holds the Welcome page (which it closes)
Show the New Tab page every time the Local Agent is opened or focused
Never open it by itself (the command Open New Tab still does)
localAgentBridge.newTab.markdownDescription: The **New Tab** page in the editor area: a composer that starts an agent chat, open tabs, this workspace's panels (Changes, Browser, Terminal, Files, Canvas, Side Chat), canvases, your `localAgentBridge.agent.panels` and recent chats.

label.description: Name shown in the empty chat

icon.description: One character or emoji shown before the label

command.description: Command id to run, e.g. one contributed by another extension

url.description: Address opened in the browser panel beside the editor

file.description: File to open; .canvas.tsx files open in the canvas preview

prompt.description: Text put into the input box

localAgentBridge.agent.panels.markdownDescription: Extra panels listed in an empty Agent chat, under **Panels**, beside Open Tabs, Changes, Browser, Terminal, Files, Canvas and Side Chat. Each entry has a `label` and one of `command` (with `args`), `url`, `file` or `prompt`. Example: `{ "label": "Storybook", "icon": "📚", "url": "http://localhost:6006" }`.
